BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC has announced the purchase of 735,625 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities. The purchases were made at a volume-weighted average price of 873.3388 pence per share, with the highest price paid being 881.0000 pence and the lowest at 870.7000 pence. These transactions are part of a share buyback program initiated on March 2, 2026, and are expected to conclude by June 5, 2026. Sage intends to cancel all acquired shares. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 26 May 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 4 / 77 pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc (''JPMS''). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026. Ordinary Shares Date of purchase: 26 May 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 735,625 Highest price paid per share: 881.0000 Lowest price paid per share: 870.7000 Volume weighted average price paid per share: 873.3388 Sage will cancel all the purchased shares.
